note.label: Called to Magnify the Law: Lord Increase Our Faith

precepts.why:
“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” What are we coming out of? What this society promotes: adultery, the music, murder, sodomy, homosexuality, drunkenness, drug abuse, idolatry, wicked entertainment and corruption. All the things God hates, against his laws, statutes and commandments, and all of it deceives us. We must expose this evil so you can learn how to save your own soul. Look at what they call the YNs: our people smoking, toting guns, women with guns bigger than they are, little kids holding bullets. And then they call us a hate group when we are trying to stop the evil within our own community first.

Sin is deceitful, and America has blurred the line. Your president even asks, what do you have to lose? Choose the worst of both evils. Isaiah 5:20: “Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!” Woe is destruction unto them. That is how they blur the line between good and evil.

Who does that? Your pastor. Many a black church on every corner facilitates the continuance of your oppression. So you have to choose a side: righteousness, your heritage, your nation, keeping God’s commandments.

That is the second step: study, pray, apply, see yourself in the scriptures, and then show your faith by separating yourself from evil. Our purpose is Acts 26:18: “To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God”. That is coming out of her.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
“And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness. And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night.” Moses wrote these things the way God told him to, hiding them so that not everyone would understand. This is the first day, before the earth was created, and the first thing created was Christ. What else was created on that first day?

Isaiah 5:20 names light and darkness plainly: “Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!” Darkness is called evil and light is called good. So when the Lord divided the light from the darkness, he created good and evil. Moses is letting us know that something more is going on in Genesis 1.

On that first day spirits were created: angels were created, evil was created, Satan was created. The dividing of the light from the darkness is God choosing. The children of light are his chosen, and the rest he hardens, as the next scriptures show.

precepts.text: The Most High will take away the hedge of His vineyard, lay it waste, and command the clouds to rain no rain, the same desolation promised over Jerusalem.
precepts.point: He will forsake the remnant of His inheritance and deliver them into the hand of their enemies to be a prey and a spoil, because they have provoked Him to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt. The Most High has borne with this wickedness for hundreds of years.

note.label: 2 Kings 21: The Wickedness of Manasseh and Amon

precepts.why:
“I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down: And I will lay it waste”, and “I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.”

Israel is his vineyard, and this is the same desolation promised over Jerusalem for Manasseh’s wickedness: “I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.” What was done to Samaria reaches Judah. The hedge comes down, and the remnant of his inheritance becomes “a prey and a spoil to all their enemies.”

precepts.text: The people are gone into captivity for having no knowledge, and hell, meaning captivity, has enlarged herself and opened her mouth without measure.
precepts.point: He will forsake the remnant of His inheritance and deliver them into the hand of their enemies to be a prey and a spoil, because they have provoked Him to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt. The Most High has borne with this wickedness for hundreds of years.

note.label: 2 Kings 21: The Wickedness of Manasseh and Amon

precepts.why:
“Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst. Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure.”

Hell here means captivity. Having no knowledge, the people go into captivity, and it opens its mouth without measure: “their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.”

That is the evil the Most High brought on Jerusalem and Judah, such that “whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle”: the remnant of his inheritance delivered into the hand of their enemies.

note.label: Proverbs 17: Trials That Refine and the Weight of Words

precepts.why:
“Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!” To call evil good is to justify the wicked, and to call good evil is to condemn the just, both an abomination to the Most High.

Those who justify the wicked do it for reward, and the reward usually comes as a financial gift or a place of importance. Woe to them.

note.label: Song of Solomon 8: Love Strong as Death, the Vineyard of Israel

precepts.why:
Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon and let it out to keepers. What is the vineyard? “For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.”

The vineyard repeated through the whole book is Israel. Wherever Solomon names the vineyard, the fruit or the garden, he is speaking of the house of Israel, and the men of Judah are his pleasant plant.

note.label: America and the World Will Pay Reparations

precepts.why:
To explain the hell we’re at agreement with. “Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge”: no knowledge of God’s laws. “And their honourable men are famished”: famished from knowing God’s truth. “And their multitude dried up with thirst”: the multitudes of our people don’t know God’s truth, his laws either.

“Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure”: hell is the lowest state, and it means there’s stages, there’s levels. When we think about hell we think about slavery. We got released from slavery, but we were mentally destroyed. And it ain’t just that: as a whole, not the one or two of you that got some money on the side, we are financially in hell, we are mentally in hell, we are spiritually in hell. We don’t even know our nationality. Our families are destroyed; that’s another form of hell. So this hell includes a litany of things: slavery, physical, mental, spiritual degradation, poverty, lack of education, bad health. Hell hath enlarged herself: it’s gotten worse and worse over time.

“And their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it”: all of our people that rejoice have descended into hell.

Put verse 13 with verse 14 and it’s telling you that hell is captivity, in its various states. People are quick to say I’m not in captivity, I’m free. Like Jason Whitlock: he was on the show saying I’m free; he makes maybe 10 million dollars a year, but according to the word of God he don’t know who he is, he don’t know what race he comes from, and the nation of people around him are destitute, impoverished. And he’s like no, but I’m free, white folks love me. No bro, you don’t rise above the status of your people. You’re in captivity right along with the rest of us.

note.label: THE DECEPTION OF SIN

precepts.why:
“Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter! Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!” This is the world we live in now, where they call good evil and evil good.

The Bishop put a question to the class: how would we truly feel if within the next minute Esau were no longer ruling us, every Edomite gone, and we were in charge right now? We would be in trouble. It would be complete pandemonium, because we just read it: woe unto them that call evil good and good evil. All the righteousness we think will spread to the four corners of the earth, our own people would call wrong and want to take us out. Imagine coming out of here like Israel out of Egypt and going into the wilderness with the bonnets and hair hats, the twerking, the gangs and the fraternities. Impossible. We are not there yet, but we are going to get there.

And if he did, we would have still rebelled, and he knew that. “Wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?”

note.label: | SABBATH MORNING CLASS: When The Harvest Is Ripe

points: “And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard”: because you want to rebel against me, now I’m going to show you what I’m going to do to you. “I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up”. The Most High has been our protection. Once he took that protection, that’s when our enemies was able to come in, and it’s a direct result of sin. Don’t forget that.

“And break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down”. He prophesied our demise multiple times. We gonna have to go through this in order to get back right with God. Lord’s will, this class could be some encouragement and upliftment for you as we continue to see the prophecies unfold, the dangers around us increase, the pestilence, the seditions.

note.label: | SABBATH MORNING CLASS: When The Harvest Is Ripe

points: “And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned”. Think about a vineyard, a crop: what’s gonna happen if you don’t water it, if you don’t shelter it from the cold? It’s going to be destroyed. What happened to us? We became destroyed as a people. He’s not gonna take care of his vineyard anymore: “nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.”
We had everything, all of those benefits from the Most High God, and he took them away, and over time we waxed worse and worse and worse.

note.label: | SABBATH MORNING CLASS: When The Harvest Is Ripe

points: Here is how they are going to hell. “Therefore my people are gone into captivity”: why did we go onto those slave ships? Why are we torn up in our communities? All our existence has been a living hell. My people are the Israelites. “Because they have no knowledge”: the knowledge is the laws of God. When we don’t have it, we go into captivity and are destroyed. That is the living hell.

We are still slaves today. We have been in slavery and captivity so long that we have normalized it: normalized the abuse, the trauma, broken homes, no daddy at home, our sons going to prison, drugs. We don’t even know what it is to really live. We are dead people.

“And their honourable men are famished”: these are the preachers and pastors you look up to, T.D. Jakes, Rex Humbard, Benny Hinn, Pam, Phillip Anthony Mitchell, especially the black ones. Famished means they themselves are empty of God’s laws. They can’t teach the Bible, so how are they going to teach you? “And their multitude dried up with thirst”: the people listening to the famished leaders are not being fed, because the man who is supposed to feed them has no knowledge to give. They come in sick and go out sicker. No water is being poured on those dry bones. The whole church is dead.

note.label: 2819 CHURCH & THE ACCESS PORTAL TO HELL

points: “Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure”. Because we have no knowledge and are not being fed, our condition of hell has gotten worse, and we don’t even know it. We have normalized hell. Many of our people think we will never get out of this, that this is where we belong. Imagine that in five minutes nobody else was ruling and the world was yours: many would be horrified, because we have been so domesticated under tyranny that we say, Daddy feed me, Daddy take care of me. Like the people going crazy over food stamps being cut, then calm the moment they hear it is restored.

“And their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.” Our glory, all we are supposed to be about, is dried up and gone. Everything we have done in this system that was supposed to benefit us, the nations have taken: music, dance, economics, education. We are not going to win this unless we turn back to the Most High, organize the way he told us to under him, and keep his commandments. That is when we will have the hedge of protection in the midst of our enemies.
